name: Integral
tagline: Licenses, plans and feature entitlements for developers who sell software. Signed offline license keys, Polar.sh license keys and React feature gates, without a licensing SaaS.
seoTitle: Integral – software licensing, license keys and entitlements for Polar.sh, Node and React
description:
Integral is a library for developers who sell software: desktop apps, self-hosted tools, CLIs or paid libraries. Licenses are signed with Ed25519 or ECDSA P-256 on your side and verified offline in your app with the public key, so nobody can forge or change one, and no licensing server has to be reachable at runtime. Declare plans with features and limits once, then ask `has("export")` or `check("projects", used)` anywhere.

Polar.sh is built in: validate, activate and deactivate Polar license keys through Polar's public API, with a cache and grace period so customers are not locked out offline. Licenses can end updates instead of usage, so versions released before the end keep working after a cancellation. Zero dependencies, runs in Node, browsers and edge runtimes, MIT-licensed. Integral Pro adds a license server that turns Polar orders and subscriptions (and, in beta, Stripe, Paddle and Lemon Squeezy) into signed licenses automatically, signing with keys in a KMS or HSM, and a React activation view.

notes: After cancelling, every version you already received keeps working. Only updates and repository access end.
Your own customers never need a licence for Integral Pro, even though the activation view ships inside your app.
Agency and Lifetime cover up to ten named people for one price: you choose the number of seats at checkout and assign them in Polar.
Checkout, invoices and VAT are handled by Polar as merchant of record.

faq.q: How is this different from Keygen or other licensing services?
faq.a: Integral is a library, not a hosted API. Licenses are signed by you and checked offline in your app, so there is no monthly fee per license and no outage that locks out your customers. With Integral Pro you run the license server yourself, next to your app.

Anyone who can change your application can remove a license check, with any licensing tool. What they cannot do is create or change a license without your private key. Integral makes honest use easy and dishonest use deliberate.

faq.q: Which signature algorithms and key stores does Integral support?
faq.a: Ed25519 and ECDSA P-256. P-256 is what AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS, Azure Key Vault and HashiCorp Vault sign with, so Integral Pro 2.0 can issue licenses without the private key ever being in your server. The Vault adapter is tested against a mocked API; the cloud KMS recipes and the Stripe, Paddle and Lemon Squeezy sources are beta and not yet verified with real accounts.
No. The free package signs and checks its own licenses with any shop or none. Polar is built in because it handles payments, invoices and VAT as merchant of record and has license keys of its own.

faq.q: What happens to my customers when they cancel?
faq.a: You decide. By default Integral Pro limits the license to the paid update period: versions released until then keep working, newer ones ask for a renewal. Set it to expire instead if you prefer.

faq.q: Do my customers need a licence for Integral Pro?
faq.a: No. The licence covers the people building your software. Your customers and the apps you ship to them need nothing.

faq.q: Can I use the open-source part on its own?
faq.a: Yes. @sweberdev/integral and @sweberdev/integral-react are MIT-licensed and complete without Pro.
